title: Redis: Distributed Cache, Locks, Bus and Data Protection | Orchard Core
description:
When Orchard Core runs on several servers, each server keeps its own cache, signals, locks and data protection keys, so the servers do not share their state.

The Redis module moves that state to a shared Redis server. You connect the site with one connection string, enable the features you need, and check the connection with a health check.

In this video:
• Why each server keeps its own state by default
• The Redis section of the configuration, and what happens when it is missing or invalid
• Enabling Redis, Redis Cache, Redis Bus and Redis Lock from the Features page
• Checking the connection with Redis Health Check
• Redis Cache: the distributed cache and the tag cache
• Redis Bus: signals that reach every server
• Redis Lock: named locks for Auto Setup and atomic background tasks
• Data protection keys in Redis, and why Redis needs persistence
• Using IRedisService and IsRedisConfigured in your own module
